is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae sensu lato.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the presence of kdr resistance (L1014) in the study population (page 4) but does not report any new genotype data or frequencies for these markers in the current study; it only references previous work (Ngufor et al. 2015) for the resistance profile.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported for the mosquitoes used in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Cové, Benin.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study on the efficacy of a new insecticide-treated net.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Cové, Southern Benin.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The hut trial lasted for 52 nights between November 2017 and February 2018.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new experimental hut trial for a specific net product (Royal Guard).

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data, so no supplement is needed for that purpose.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of Royal Guard, a new alpha-cypermethrin and pyriproxyfen treated mosquito net, in laboratory and experimental hut trials in Cové, Benin. While the study mentions the presence of kdr resistance in the local vector population, it does not generate or report any new genotype data for insecticide-resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report any new genotype data for insecticide-resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported.
